questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Lomé?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Togo is Lomé.

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Togo on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Togo on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.prompt: What money is used in Togo?

hints.nudge: Money names often come from a country’s own words. The other three are spent in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the part of the article about the economy, or at the facts for the country.

questions.proof: The money used in Togo is the West African CFA franc.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Togo?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Togo article.

questions.proof: The capital city Lomé is located along the Gulf of Guinea.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Togo?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Togo on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Togo article.

questions.proof: It is bordered by Ghana to the west, Benin to the east and Burkina Faso to the north.
